title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1998 16.3.2 As per the information received from the States, the number of complaints received per 100 Police Personnel (Civil + Armed) were as under: Madhya Pradesh 23.0; Punjab 8.4; Uttar Pradesh 2.6; Tamil Nadu 2.4; Kerala 2.2 and Rajasthan 2.1. Among the UTs, Delhi UT reported 91.2 complaints per 100 Police Personnel. Interestingly the number of complaints which turned out to be false, or un-sustained in Delhi were only 0.4 complaints per 100 Police Personnel as against the national level average of 2.4 during this year. The All-India average of complaints per 100 personnel during 1998 stood at 6.7.
